# Task List

1. ✅ Create folder structure for consumer_order_items entity
   Create directories: demo/src/consumer_order_items/consumer_order_items_bronze/transformations/, demo/src/consumer_order_items/consumer_order_items_silver/transformations/, demo/resources/pipelines/consumer_order_items/

2. ✅ Create bronze pipeline transformation files
   Create landing.py and bronze.py under demo/src/consumer_order_items/consumer_order_items_bronze/transformations/ based on metadata processing rules

3. ✅ Create silver pipeline transformation file
   Create silver.py under demo/src/consumer_order_items/consumer_order_items_silver/transformations/ based on metadata processing rules

4. ✅ Create consumer_order_items_bronze_pipeline.yml
   Pipeline config with target consumer_order_items_bronze, correct library paths, and configuration variables

5. ✅ Create consumer_order_items_silver_pipeline.yml
   Pipeline config with target consumer_order_items_silver, correct library path, and configuration variables

6. ✅ Create consumer_order_items_job.yml
   Job config with name consumer_order_items_workflow, file_arrival trigger, and bronze->silver tasks

7. ✅ Update project_metadata.json
   Add entity to bootstrap.entities and add run_consumer_order_items_job task to dependency_graph

8. ✅ Update bootstrap_job.yml
   Add run_consumer_order_items_job task with depends_on referencing the previous entity job

9. ✅ Verify databricks.yml inclusion patterns and variables
   Ensure resources/**/*.yml includes all new files and all required variables are declared
